name: LLM gateway: wybór modelu
description: Measures whether the model can route a user request to the right model tier (small, large, code or web search).
instructions: Which model tier should handle this request?

criteria.small_model: Short, simple tasks: greetings, quick facts, rephrasing a sentence, simple translation, yes/no questions
criteria.large_model: Multi-step reasoning, long documents, analysis, planning, nuanced writing or advice
criteria.code_model: Writing, fixing, explaining or reviewing source code, SQL or shell scripts
criteria.web_search: Needs current information: news, prices, weather, today's schedules, recent events
